_doc: Extractive QA over the Shaik (2025) LegacyRAG paper as the RAG corpus. Each question's answer is spread across the document (not one repeated sentence), de-confounding the pathological-fixture issue (register V1). gold = list of acceptable substrings (case-insensitive); answer counts correct if ANY gold appears in the generation.

questions.q: What GPU does the LegacyRAG system run on, and what is that GPU's memory bandwidth?
What percentage of the total RAG pipeline latency is consumed by generation?
By what factor does naive dual-GPU layer splitting degrade prompt prefill throughput?
Which language model and quantization format does LegacyRAG use for generation?
What generation speedup does the Vulkan backend achieve over CPU-only inference?
What free-VRAM threshold does the scheduler use to decide when to route work to the CPU?
Which embedding model does LegacyRAG use to embed document chunks?
How many out-of-memory events occurred during the scheduler evaluation?
